fields.title: Backend Developer
fields.bio: I am a passionate Backend Developer dedicated to building scalable, robust, and high-performance web applications. Specializing in designing clean RESTful APIs, database architecture, and efficient server-side logic, I enjoy turning complex problem statements into seamless digital solutions. I am constantly exploring modern tech stacks and best development practices to craft reliable backend systems that power great user experiences.

fields.title: Ecommerce
fields.description: Cado Fashion (repo: Ecommerce) is a full-stack fashion e-commerce platform built with Python & Django — originally started as Puddle, a second-hand marketplace prototype, and iteratively evolved into a full retail storefront for verified sellers across Bangladesh. Customers can browse curated categories (Men's, Baby items, Children's Drop Shoulders, Clothing, Adults Drop Shoulders), search products, add items to a cart or wishlist, leave reviews, message sellers in real time, and sellers get their own dashboard with Chart.js-powered analytics.

fields.title: Social Media Manager
fields.description: Social Media Manager is a Django-powered dashboard that centralizes social media operations — connecting brand accounts (Facebook Pages, LinkedIn, and more), scheduling and auto-publishing posts, managing media, and replying to messages from a single unified inbox. Built with Celery + Redis for reliable background task scheduling, it's designed for freelancers, agencies, and small brands who juggle multiple platforms daily.

fields.title: Cash Management Django App
fields.description: Cash Management App is a multi-user Django application for tracking shared finances across collaborative projects. Multiple users can join a project, log transactions under organized categories, and keep a fully auditable trail of every change — with email alerts keeping everyone in the loop. Built with a clean, dark-themed UI for comfortable day-to-day use.

fields.title: Django Authentication System
fields.description: Full Django Auth is a robust, secure user authentication system built with Python and Django, following the MVT (Model-View-Template) architecture. It's designed as a production-ready foundation for any web app that needs solid, drop-in user management — registration, login/logout, and full password lifecycle handling.

fields.title: Hospital Management SQL DML
fields.description:
# 🏥 Hospital Management System (HMS) - Database Schema

A robust, relational database architecture designed to manage core hospital operations, including patient registration, staff management, diagnostic reporting, and billing processes.

## 🚀 Key Features

* **Comprehensive Data Model**: Includes 10+ interconnected tables managing everything from employee designations to patient blood groups.
* **Data Integrity**: Uses primary and foreign key constraints to ensure consistent relationships between patients, doctors, and medical records.
* **Operational Tracking**: Implements `IDENTITY` for automated ID generation and `DEFAULT GETDATE()` to track transaction times for reports and invoices.
* **Advanced Reporting**: Features a pre-configured View (`vwPatientsDetails`) that joins multiple tables to provide a "one-stop" diagnostic report.

## 📊 Database Schema

The system is organized into several functional areas:
* **HR Management**: `Departments`, `Designations`, and `Employees`.
* **Patient Records**: `Patients` and `BloodGroups`.
* **Clinical Operations**: `Appointments`, `DiagnosticTests`, and `TestReports`.
* **Inventory & Finance**: `Categories`, `Products`, `InventoryTransactions`, and `Invoices`.

## 🛠️ Technical Details

* **Language**: T-SQL (Microsoft SQL Server).
* **Optimization**: Tables are normalized to reduce redundancy and ensure efficient querying.
* **Sample Data**: Includes a DML script with 20+ records for each table to simulate a live hospital environment.

## 🚀 Getting Started

1.  **Environment**: Ensure you have SQL Server and SSMS (SQL Server Management Studio) installed.
2.  **Schema Setup**: Execute `HospitalManagementDb.sql` to create the database and its structures.
3.  **Data Population**: Execute `Hospital Management System DML.sql` to insert sample patients, doctors, and reports.
4.  **Verification**: Run the following command to view consolidated patient reports:
    ```sql
    SELECT * FROM vwPatientsDetails;
    ```

---
*Developed by Md. Sakib Howlader (Nawab Sakib)*

Designed and built full-stack Django applications end-to-end for independent clients and self-initiated products, taking each project from database design through deployment. Delivered a production e-commerce platform with cart, wishlist, review, and seller/buyer role systems backed by a relational database; built a multi-user financial tracking app with audit logging and email notifications; and developed a social media management tool for scheduling and engagement tracking. Worked across the full backend stack — models, views, forms, authentication, and third-party integrations (Cloudinary, AJAX, SMTP) — while managing deployment on Render.
